  • A natural relationship builder who can influence outcomes and work effectively with senior leaders

This is a High-profile internal finance role giving you an opportunity to work within a well-established, values-driven organisation with a strong reputation in the NZ market.  

Interested?
Apply now, or contact Tash Zyzalo for a confidential discussion on tash@momentum.co.nz.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
The business supports the payment services millions of Kiwis rely on every day. You'll get hands-on month-end accounting experience, work from home flexibly, and have the chance to learn something new every month.

Why you'll love it
· Work from home. Flexible working, so you can do your best work where it suits you.
· A fun team. A close, friendly Finance team that works hard, supports each other and enjoys it.
· A great central location. An easy-to-reach city office with plenty of cafés and transport on the doorstep.
· Opportunity to learn. Build practical experience across month-end accounting, projects, fixed assets, tax and reporting.

The role
This is a hands-on accounting role. You'll support a Fast Close month-end process that delivers Day 1 reporting to the business. Your day-to-day will include:
· Preparing and posting month-end journals: accruals, prepayments, revenue, depreciation and WIP
· Bank, suspense and balance sheet reconciliations
· Contractor and permanent staff timesheet accounting
· Project accounting, WIP and capitalisation
· Fixed asset management
· Customer billing and revenue support
· Management and project reporting, GST workpapers, and quarterly Stats NZ reporting
· Working with project managers, auditors and suppliers to investigate variances and resolve exceptions

About you
· An accounting qualification, with practical experience in journals, reconciliations and month-end processing
· Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills, including pivot tables and variance analysis
· Experience with enterprise finance systems and structured month-end processes
· High attention to detail and a record of meeting recurring deadlines
· The confidence to question unusual results, follow up missing information and raise errors early
· Clear written and verbal communication
· A practical, flexible approach, and a willingness to own routine tasks as well as the more analytical ones

This is a great opportunity within a sector that is constantly changing and innovating. They have plenty of interesting projects coming up that you could be part of. It’s a busy role working with a stable happy team.

If this sounds like a role for you then act now.

This is the first and highest-priority project in a wider technology programme, with a customer-experience-led design and a "one team, one plan" delivery approach. About you
You are outgoing, positive and a confident communicator. You'll work closely with business leads and the vendor every day. You build trust quickly and can hold a line constructively when pressure builds for exceptions.

Essential
  • 5+ years' business analysis experience on large, complex system implementations.
  • Hands-on delivery of at least one SaaS or COTS implementation, working to the vendor's methodology.
  • Proven ability to work with multiple business units and a wide range of stakeholders, including senior business leads and vendor specialists.
  • Experience designing end-to-end customer journeys and processes for a customer-facing or transactional service (utilities, telecommunications, banking, insurance or similar).
  • Strong skills in facilitation, documentation, process design, business rules, data analysis and acceptance testing.
  • Experience in an iterative or agile design–build–test cycle at a vendor-led pace.
  • Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence and Visio (or equivalents).
  • Tertiary qualification or equivalent experience.
Desirable
  • Utility customer care and billing experience (accounts, billing, payments, credit and debt), or experience with a modern utility billing platform.
  • Data migration analysis from multiple legacy sources.
  • NZ public sector or council-controlled organisation experience, including the Privacy Act 2020 and Official Information Act 1982.
  • Certification such as IIBA CBAP/CCBA or Agile BA.
What you'll bring
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a pragmatic, outcome-focused approach.
  • A customer-first mindset.
  • A collaborative style that adapts to the audience.
